generations.prompt: Inside a small candlelit upstairs room at night: a young woman in a white linen chemise and a bearded man in an open white linen shirt sit close together on the edge of a straw bed, a jester's tunic with bells thrown over its foot, a casement window open to the moonlight at the left, a heavy plank door at the right. She laughs softly and dabs the bruise on his cheekbone with her red scarf; he grins at her. Then both of their heads snap toward the door at the right and they freeze, listening, her hand still raised; they turn and look at each other, eyes wide; a grin spreads over his face and she presses the scarf to her mouth to stifle a laugh. Camera static. Photoreal, cinematic film look, 35mm, shallow depth of field, film grain. No text, no captions.
